mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 8.5% signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 recession recovery phase, a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, which lowers borrowing costs and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) triggers concerns about central bank tightening, leading to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises by at least 0.3% and UNRATE falls by at least 0.1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.5% (computed from GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is above 2.5% annualized.
